verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal provides a built-in simulated card reader in its SDKs and server-driven integration so developers can test integrations without physical hardware, and Stripe CLI supports scripting/automation of API interactions — both usable in CI pipelines. However, Terminal's core function is in-person payment hardware, so full headless/production operation isn't the target use case, and there's no dedicated CI/automation guide or evidence of running actual payment flows unattended in a pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation, evidence of automated end-to-end headless payment testing, and confirmation that the simulated reader covers all Terminal features needed for full automation.
